messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PI-4382 triggered: 'redis: maxclients reached' — Severity: P1 — paging channel: eng-oncall
pagerduty: Page fired to rotation: eng-oncall-primary — incident link https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PI-4382
Kai Nguyen: ack'd — I'm on it, grabbing sharding/metrics
Julie (oncall): oncall here, starting triage, please post any error logs and runbook links
Priya Sharma: seeing spike in redis `aof-01` maxclients, redis stats: connected_clients=1024 (maxclients=1024), evicted_keys=0, rejected connections in logs
Sam Ortiz: also seeing Postgres connection queue rising on api-db-read: 180 -> 400, 5xx rates up 3x
Kai Nguyen: looks like frontend burst from model-inference batcher — check infra:embeddings-service -> memory growth and many stalled requests
Julie (oncall): run `redis-cli -h redis-a-01 INFO clients` and post snippet
Kai Nguyen: pasted:
```
# Clients
connected_clients:1024
client_longest_output_list:0
client_biggest_input_buf:0
blocked_clients:15
```
Priya Sharma: `blocked_clients` high, probably clients are blocked waiting on replies -> connection leak in client side or exhausted pool
SRE Rotations: @Kai can you check LB metrics; maybe a new deployment caused retry storm
Kai Nguyen: checked, deploy `service/embeddings` rolled 1h ago; new config `max_parallel_requests=32` changed to 128 accidentally
Sam Ortiz: ohhh that's it. New batcher parallelism increased concurrency causing many clients to open long-lived connections
Julie (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) temp scale redis replicas read-only to take traffic 2) revert embeddings config to previous value 3) apply pgbouncer pool size cap to prevent pg exhaustion
Priya Sharma: starting step 1: adding two read replicas now (region-us-west). ETA ~90s
Kai Nguyen: rolling back embeddings canary to previous image now: `kubectl set image deployment/embeddings canary=images/embeddings:v2.1.3` — doing now
ops-bot: deploybot: rollback triggered for deployment embeddings/canary by Kai Nguyen at 4955556835
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by Julie (oncall)
Kai Nguyen: rollback succeeded, canary traffic cut. Observability: connection attempts down by ~70% in last 30s
Priya Sharma: redis connected_clients -> 400 now, blocked_clients=2
Sam Ortiz: PG connections dropping to 120; 5xx rate trending down
Julie (oncall): great. Who will own postmortem? Need customer impact assessment: which customers experienced errors
Kai Nguyen: quick grep across logs: customer-calls with error 502 between 17:01-17:08 UTC: corp-alpha, startup-beta, partner-gamma (small volumes)
Sam Ortiz: notified support to reach out. Creating incident ticket INT-2026 and tagging accounts
Julie (oncall): set status page? impact: partial degradation for embeddings generation (latency & 502s) for a subset of customers. Suggest statuspage incident 'Degraded performance for embeddings API'
Priya Sharma: statuspage updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INT-2026 — note: mitigation applied, monitoring
SRE Rotations: recommend follow-ups: add validation to PR that increases `max_parallel_requests` above 64 must be blocked, add metrics alert for `blocked_clients>10` and `redis connected_clients > 0.8*maxclients`
Kai Nguyen: adding ticket to infra backlog: TKT-844
Julie (oncall): handing back to normal ops in 30m after monitoring stable. Oncall handoff to night shift: @Sam will watch next 2h
Sam Ortiz: ack, will monitor. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident-bot: incident PI-4382 resolved by Julie (oncall) at 4955556870 — monitoring
Kai Nguyen: logs and snippets uploaded to ticket INT-2026
Julie (oncall): thanks everyone. Postmortem owner: Kai. Send preliminary postmortem by EOD
Priya Sharma: copying runbook reference: /runbooks/redis-maxclients.md
Sam Ortiz: closing notes: root cause = misconfigured canary that increased concurrency -> client connection churn -> redis maxclients hit -> PG pool pressure
Julie (oncall): closing thread, will reopen if regression
